name: APINACA
summary: APINACA (AKB48, N-(1-adamantyl)-1-pentyl-1H-indazole-3-carboxamide) is a drug that acts as a reasonably potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors.68 nM. Its pharmacological characterization has also been reported in a discontinued patent application.

pharmacology.text: APINACA (AKB48, N-(1-adamantyl)-1-pentyl-1H-indazole-3-carboxamide) is a drug that acts as a reasonably potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors.

uses.text: Its pharmacological characterization has also been reported in a discontinued patent application. It was deliberately being sold named after a popular girl band called AKB48.

summaryZh: APINACA（N-(1-金剛烷)-1-戊基-1H-吲唑-3-甲醯胺）是一種潛在的大麻素受體激動劑，在黑市上以日本女團「AKB48」的名字銷售。此前它從未在科學界或專利文獻中被報道過，2012年3月在日本的實驗室中作為合成大麻混合煙的原料被識別出來。
summaryZhHans: APINACA（N-(1-金刚烷)-1-戊基-1H-吲唑-3-甲酰胺）是一种潜在的大麻素受体激动剂，在黑市上以日本女团“AKB48”的名字销售。此前它从未在科学界或专利文献中被报道过，2012年3月在日本的实验室中作为合成大麻混合烟的原料被识别出来。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, confusion, seizures and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁動、嘔吐、混亂、癲癇發作與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁动、呕吐、混乱、癫痫发作与精神病。

fact.en: Its other name, AKB48, was borrowed from the Japanese pop group of that name. The AKB in the chemical sense simply came first in a patent, and the coincidence stuck in the drug market.
fact.zh: 它的另一個名稱 AKB48 借自同名的日本流行音樂團體。在化學意義上，AKB 只是先出現在一項專利中，而這個巧合便在藥物市場上流傳下來。
fact.zhHans: 它的另一个名称 AKB48 借自同名的日本流行音乐团体。在化学意义上，AKB 只是先出现在一项专利中，而这个巧合便在药物市场上流传下来。
